plugins.name: self-learning-memory
plugins.description: Self-learning memory: logs failed tool calls, distills them into caveman lessons, injects at session start. Includes memory-hygiene skill.

plugins.name: auto-pr-maintenance
plugins.description: Automatically keeps your PR description accurate and review threads resolved after every git push. A PostToolUse hook detects pushes to branches with open PRs and reminds the agent to run the post-push-pr-maintenance skill, which reconciles the description with the current diff and handles automated reviewer threads.
